title: Predictable QoS Profiles for Hosted Inference (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) — PRD + Launch Checklist
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Customers need reliable latency and cost tradeoffs for hosted endpoints (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank). There is currently variability across models and routes that causes customer tickets and poor SLAs. Goal: Define and ship a QoS profile mechanism and related runtime defaults so users can pick predictable latency/cost bands, with telemetry and rollout gates for launch.
scope: Define QoS profile API/console surface, backend routing defaults, telemetry gating, canary rollout plan, billing labels, and acceptance tests for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints.
out_of_scope: Per-customer dedicated capacity (Dedicated product), deep model changes, or new quantization features. On-prem private deployment rollout will be follow-on (not in initial launch).
requirements: REQ-1: API flag 'qos_profile' on create endpoint and runtime call-level override: values = ['low-latency','balanced','cost-optimized']
REQ-2: Console UX to select default QoS profile per route and show estimated p50/p95 latency and token cost delta
REQ-3: Runtime routing rules to prefer low-latency model variants, with automatic fallthrough to balanced then cost-optimized under load
REQ-4: Telemetry: p50/p95/p99 latency per profile, token cost per profile, request success/error rates, and queue/backpressure metrics
REQ-5: Canary and rollout controls tied to profile: ability to slice traffic by tenant, percent, and region
REQ-6: Billing tagging so invoice shows profile-level cost breakdown for first month after launch
REQ-7: Backwards compatibility: default behavior for existing endpoints must remain unchanged unless customer opts in
REQ-8: Safety: profiles must respect existing model compatibility rules; rerank and embeddings must not be silently swapped between model families
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Default 'balanced' profile returns p95 latency within defined band for the top 3 supported models for each endpoint type under 95th percentile test load
AC-2: Low-latency profile yields >=20% p95 improvement vs balanced on controlled benchmark with <10% cost increase
AC-3: Cost-optimized profile yields >=15% reduction in per-token cost vs balanced for embedding-heavy workloads without violating p95 upper bound
AC-4: Console shows estimated latency and cost delta within +/-15% of observed telemetry after 48 hours of production traffic
AC-5: Canary rollout: 0.5% tenant traffic slice produces no critical errors and latency regressions; rollback can be executed via single button and completes within 10 minutes
AC-6: Billing tags validated end-to-end in staging and sample invoice demonstrating profile-level line items
AC-7: End-to-end automated tests (unit + integration) covering profile selection, fallback behavior, and error handling are added to CI and pass on the release branch
launch_checklist: LC-1: API spec updated and published (OpenAPI + SDK changelogs)
LC-2: Console UI mock approved by Design and implemented in staging
LC-3: Runtime routing knobs implemented and feature-flagged
LC-4: Telemetry dashboards created: profile latency/cost and alerts configured
LC-5: Canary plan scheduled with traffic slices and target tenants identified
LC-6: Load test matrix executed for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank across profiles and documented
LC-7: Billing integration smoke tested with finance team
LC-8: Support playbook and FAQ drafted and reviewed by Solutions Engineering
LC-9: Rollback and mitigation runbook validated (including model variant rollbacks and traffic re-routing)
LC-10: Legal/compliance check completed for any billing text changes
LC-11: Stakeholder signoffs: Eng (runtime), PM, Design, Observability, Billing, Support
LC-12: Launch cutover window booked and communicated to SRE on-call
risks_mitigations: Risk: Profiles cause unexpected model swaps resulting in quality regressions. Mitigation: enforce model-family guardrails and include similarity/eval checks in canary.
Risk: Billing misattribution. Mitigation: end-to-end billing smoke with finance and tag propagation checks in staging.
Risk: Telemetry lag hides regressions. Mitigation: set short retention rolls for new metrics and high-sensitivity alerts during canary.
Risk: Customer confusion about defaults. Mitigation: default to 'balanced' and provide migration docs and clear console labeling.
